metadata.repair: Curve repaired after conversion: the pack's six-parameter fit closes its tone ladder in 0.43-1.13 log exposure units where a colour negative takes 2.5-3.8, so each record was re-laid on 3.50 logE about its own 5-95 % midpoint (density range, dMin and 18 % grey point unchanged). The invented sum(dMin*dye) base was dropped to match the reference engine, which applies no base for a pack without a separated one. See tools/convert_fotufilm_stocks.py -> LATITUDE_REFIT / NO_BASE.
